To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

AMG 101 is a neutralizing, fully human antibody that binds with high affinity and specificity to HGF, inhibits HGF-induced signaling through the c-Met receptor, and inhibits HGF-mediated cell migration.
AMG 101 is a fully human antibody that selectively binds and neutralizes HGF and that AMG 103 is a fully human HGF antibody that binds and neutralizes human HGF but not nonhuman primate HGF.

AMG 002, a fully human monocloal antibody to human and nonhuman primate hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), has a high affinity for human HGF, binds preferentially to the mature, activated form of HGF rather than the inactive pro-HGF precursor, inhibits HGF-induced cMet autophosphoryation, and inhibits HGF-dependent cell migration.
